  MEI.v2 último: bimestre 2026-10, mei 2.53, nombre SO 2026
  IRI Columbia (2026-11, texto original): To generate the CCSR/IRI objective ENSO probability outlook, forecasts from the 26 currently available models (15 dynamical and 11 statistical) in the plume are combined into an equally weighted multi-model average of Niño 3.4 SST anomalies. A Gaussian error distribution is then applied to the ensemble-mean forecast, with its width determined by the expected forecast skill for each season and lead time. Higher skill produces a narrower distribution and greater confidence, while lower skill broadens the range of possible outcomes. Probabilities are calculated for the standard ENSO categories: El Niño (≥ +0.5°C), ENSO-neutral (−0.5°C to +0.5°C), and La Niña (≤ −0.5°C). The latest objective outlook assigns a 100% probability of El Niño from NDJ 2026/27 through MAM 2027, providing exceptionally high confidence that El Niño will persist throughout boreal winter and spring.
